public_context.environment_introduction:
# Environment Information

## Brief Introduction:  
This environment encompasses a hospital’s digital management platform that orchestrates bed assignments and reservations for patients.  
It maintains the current status of beds (available, reserved, occupied), patient information, and the linkage between the two.  
Staff interact with the system to search for beds, reserve them under patient names, and manage the dynamic availability and assignments essential for efficient hospital operations.

## Environment Rules / Constraints:  
- A bed can only be reserved if its status is "available".
- Multiple beds can be reserved for a single patient.
- The same bed cannot be assigned to more than one patient at the same time.
- Reserved beds must be updated to "reserved" status and linked to the respective patient.
- Reservation actions are recorded with staff attribution for auditability.
public_context.task:
Consolidate Alice Chan’s admission to Lakeview Regional Medical Center and free up her Central City bed, with proper audit attribution to staff STF-02:

- At Lakeview Regional Medical Center, reserve two available beds specifically in ward WARD-LK-A for Alice Chan, attributed to STF-02. Use the available beds in that ward.
- Transfer the existing reservation for bed BED-LK-02 at Lakeview from Zoey McIntyre to Alice Chan, attributed to STF-02.
- Cancel Alice Chan’s existing reservation at Central City General Hospital and release that bed back to available.
- Assign Alice Chan to one of the newly reserved ward WARD-LK-A beds at Lakeview (use BED-LK-01 for the assignment).
- After assignment, cancel the temporarily transferred reservation on BED-LK-02 so it becomes available again, but keep the second ward WARD-LK-A bed (BED-LK-03) reserved under Alice for her caregiver.

Ensure all resulting bed statuses and reservation records reflect these changes (occupied for BED-LK-01, reserved for BED-LK-03 under Alice, available for BED-LK-02 and the Central City bed), with staff STF-02 recorded on the actions.

function.description:
Retrieve hospital metadata (including hospital_id) by its name.

Args:
    name (str): The name of the hospital to look up.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": HospitalInfo  # The matching hospital's info
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # "Hospital not found" if no match
    }

Constraints:
    - Hospital names are assumed unique. If multiple found, returns the first.
    - Performs an exact (case-sensitive) match.
function.name: get_hospital_by_name

function.description:
List all beds (with their current status and metadata) for a specific hospital.

Args:
    hospital_id (str): The unique identifier for the hospital.

Returns:
    dict: 
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": List[BedInfo]  # All beds belonging to the hospital (may be empty)
        }
    or
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Reason (e.g. hospital not found)
        }

Constraints:
    - The hospital_id must exist.
    - If no beds found, the returned list is empty (not an error).
function.name: list_beds_by_hospital

function.description:
List all beds in a hospital that are currently available for reservation.

Args:
    hospital_id (str): Unique identifier for the hospital.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[BedInfo],  # List of beds with status "available" in the hospital
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason, e.g., hospital not found
    }

Constraints:
    - The hospital_id must correspond to an existing hospital.
function.name: list_available_beds_by_hospital

function.description:
Retrieve patient information(s) given a patient name.

Args:
    name (str): The (case-sensitive) name of the patient to search for.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[PatientInfo]  # List of matching patient(s); empty if nobody found.
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of the error (e.g., empty name).
    }

Constraints:
    - Name must be a non-empty string.
    - Multiple patients may have the same name; all matches are returned.
    - No error if no patient matches; return empty list.
function.name: get_patient_by_name

function.description:
Retrieve patient info by patient_id.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique identifier for the patient.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": PatientInfo  # all fields
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": "Patient not found"
            }

Constraints:
    - Patient must exist in the environment.
function.name: get_patient_by_id

function.description:
Lookup staff information for a given staff_id.

Args:
    staff_id (str): The unique identifier of the staff member.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - If found: { "success": True, "data": StaffInfo }
        - If not found: { "success": False, "error": "Staff not found" }

Constraints:
    - No additional constraints except the staff_id must exist.
function.name: get_staff_by_id

function.description:
List all beds either assigned to or reserved by the specified patient.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique patient identifier.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[BedInfo]  # may be empty if no assignments/reservations
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Patient must exist in the system.
    - Will not list duplicate beds (if both assigned and reserved).
function.name: list_beds_by_patient

function.description:
List all reservations linked to a given patient.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique patient identifier.

Returns:
    dict:
        success (bool): True if patient found, False otherwise.
        data (List[ReservationInfo]): List of reservation records for the patient (may be empty).
        error (str, optional): Reason, if patient not found.

Constraints:
    - Patient must exist in the system (self.patients).
function.name: list_reservations_by_patient

function.description:
Retrieve full information about a specific bed by its bed_id.

Args:
    bed_id (str): Unique identifier of the bed.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success: {"success": True, "data": BedInfo}
        - If not found: {"success": False, "error": "Bed not found"}

Constraints:
    - No additional constraints; simple information query.
function.name: get_bed_info_by_id

function.description:
Retrieve full details of a specific reservation entry by its reservation_id.

Args:
    reservation_id (str): The reservation's unique identifier.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": ReservationInfo  # Full reservation entry if found
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # 'Reservation not found'
    }

Constraints:
    - reservation_id must exist in self.reservations
function.name: get_reservation_by_id

function.description:
Reserve an available bed under a given patient by a staff member.
Updates bed status, patient linkage, timestamps, and logs reservation for audit.

Args:
    bed_id (str): ID of the bed to reserve.
    patient_id (str): ID of the patient to link reservation.
    staff_id (str): ID of the staff member making the reservation.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str  # Success message
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Failure reason
    }

Constraints:
    - Bed must exist and be "available".
    - Patient and Staff must exist.
    - Bed status is changed to "reserved" and linked to patient.
    - Reservation record is created for auditability.
function.name: reserve_bed

function.description:
Reserve multiple available beds for a single patient in one transaction.

Args:
    patient_id (str): ID of the patient for whom beds should be reserved.
    bed_ids (List[str]): List of bed IDs to reserve.
    staff_id (str): ID of the staff making the reservation.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": <summary string>,
        "reserved_bed_ids": List[str],    # successfully reserved bed IDs
        "skipped_bed_ids": List[str],     # IDs of beds that could not be reserved (not available or missing)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str                      # error description (e.g., missing patient/staff)
    }

Constraints:
    - A bed can only be reserved if its status is "available".
    - The patient and staff must exist.
    - Reservation actions must be attributed to staff.
function.name: bulk_reserve_beds

function.description:
Cancels an existing reservation:
    - Updates reservation status to "cancelled"
    - Reverts linked bed's status to "available" if appropriate
    - Clears assigned_patient_id and reservation_timestamp for that bed if necessary

Args:
    reservation_id (str): The ID of the reservation to cancel.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: { "success": True, "message": "Reservation cancelled and bed status reverted." }
        - On failure: { "success": False, "error": str }

Constraints:
    - Reservation must exist.
    - Only cancel if the reservation is still active.
    - Bed status must be reverted to available (unless already available).
    - Maintain auditability by updating status fields.
function.name: cancel_reservation

function.description:
Assign a patient to a reserved bed, marking the bed as occupied.

Args:
    patient_id (str): The ID of the patient to assign.
    bed_id (str): The ID of the bed to assign to the patient.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Patient assigned to bed and marked as occupied."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error explanation
    }

Constraints:
    - Bed must exist and status must be "reserved".
    - Patient must exist.
    - There must be an active reservation linking patient and bed.
    - A bed cannot be assigned to more than one patient at the same time.
function.name: assign_patient_to_bed

function.description:
Frees up an occupied or reserved bed, making it available.

Args:
    bed_id (str): Unique identifier of the bed to release.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str  # Description of release action
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str    # Reason why release wasn't done
    }

Constraints:
    - The specified bed must exist.
    - Only beds with status 'reserved' or 'occupied' can be released.
    - Upon release, bed status is set to 'available', assigned patient/linkage cleared, reservation_timestamp cleared.
function.name: release_bed

function.description:
Change the status of a bed ("available", "reserved", "occupied") as per workflow requirements.

Args:
    bed_id (str): Unique identifier of the bed to update.
    new_status (str): Target status; must be one of "available", "reserved", "occupied".

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Bed status updated to <new_status>."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Reason for failure (invalid id/status/constraint violation)."
    }

Constraints:
    - Bed must exist.
    - `new_status` must be valid.
    - Status changes must comply with business rules:
        - Reservation can only occur when bed is "available".
        - Occupy typically means reserved first (not strictly enforced if workflow allows).
        - Setting to "available" may clear patient/reservation fields.
function.name: update_bed_status

function.description:
Create a new reservation record for audit/history tracking.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique ID of the patient associated with the reservation.
    bed_id (str): Unique ID of the bed being reserved.
    staff_id (str): Unique ID of the staff making the reservation (audit attribution).
    reservation_timestamp (str): ISO-formatted timestamp of reservation creation.
    reservation_status (str, optional): Status for the reservation record, defaults to "active".

Returns:
    dict: 
        Success: { "success": True, "message": "Created reservation <reservation_id>." }
        Failure: { "success": False, "error": "reason" }

Constraints:
    - patient_id, bed_id, staff_id must exist in the system.
    - All fields required for creating reservation.
    - This does NOT change bed status, only records reservation for audit/history.
function.name: create_reservation

function.description:
Change the status of an existing reservation (e.g., "active", "cancelled").

Args:
    reservation_id (str): The ID of the reservation to update.
    new_status (str): The target status ("active" or "cancelled").

Returns:
    dict:
        - success: True if updated, False otherwise.
        - message: Confirmation on success.
        - error: Reason for failure.

Constraints:
    - Reservation must exist in self.reservations.
    - new_status must be "active" or "cancelled".
function.name: update_reservation_status

function.description:
Reassign a reserved bed from one patient to another, enforcing all hospital bed constraints.

Args:
    bed_id (str): Unique identifier of the bed to transfer.
    new_patient_id (str): Unique identifier of the patient to be newly assigned the bed.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "message": "Bed assignment transferred from old_patient_id to new_patient_id for bed bed_id."
            }
        On failure:
            { 
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # Reason for failure (bed not found, not reserved, etc.)
            }

Constraints:
    - Bed must exist and currently have status "reserved".
    - new_patient_id must exist.
    - Only one patient can be linked to a bed at a time.
    - Reservation must exist and be active for the bed.
function.name: transfer_bed_assignment

function.description:
Change the status of an existing reservation (e.g., "active", "cancelled").

Args:
    reservation_id (str): The ID of the reservation to update.
    new_status (str): The target status ("active" or "cancelled").

Returns:
    dict:
        - success: True if updated, False otherwise.
        - message: Confirmation on success.
        - error: Reason for failure.

Constraints:
    - Reservation must exist in self.reservations.
    - new_status must be "active" or "cancelled".
function.name: update_reservation_status

function.description:
Reassign a reserved bed from one patient to another, enforcing all hospital bed constraints.

Args:
    bed_id (str): Unique identifier of the bed to transfer.
    new_patient_id (str): Unique identifier of the patient to be newly assigned the bed.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "message": "Bed assignment transferred from old_patient_id to new_patient_id for bed bed_id."
            }
        On failure:
            { 
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # Reason for failure (bed not found, not reserved, etc.)
            }

Constraints:
    - Bed must exist and currently have status "reserved".
    - new_patient_id must exist.
    - Only one patient can be linked to a bed at a time.
    - Reservation must exist and be active for the bed.
function.name: transfer_bed_assignment
